overview_description.description: Bensen builds software that helps restaurant brands sell stuff on voice platforms like Alexa and Google Assistant. It provides solutions that integrate with a restaurant’s current ordering system, as well its loyalty program, on the backend. When a consumer places an order by voice, it comes through the same ordering channel that an online or mobile order would. It is targeting quick-service restaurant (QSR) chains that have drive-thrus.
